# vendor

Third-party files u2 loads itself, copied unchanged so they come from the same origin as u2
(no extra CSP source, no foreign host at runtime). Update by fetching the new version over the
existing file; keep the LICENSE next to it.

| Dir | Source | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| dragdroptouch | https://bernardo-castilho.github.io/DragDropTouch/DragDropTouch.js | 2.0.3 | MIT |
| highlightjs | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/highlightjs/cdn-release@11.7.0/build/ (`es/highlight.min.js`, `styles/github.min.css`) | 11.7.0 | BSD-3-Clause |
